headlines.title: As Trump pushes for data centers, voters in key midterm races say they don’t want them
headlines.description: An NBC News Decision Desk Poll found that 69% of respondents oppose building AI data centers in their areas, with 45% saying they “strongly oppose” the idea.

headlines.title: 'Dear Donald': Battleground district voters share their message to Trump
headlines.description: On his final day of the NBC News Drive to Decision Day series, NBC News senior national politics reporter Jon Allen joins Meet the Press NOW from Nebraska to recap his trip and hisvisit to the “blue dot” district.

headlines.title: 'I am not running for president,' Attorney General Todd Blanche says at Iowa State Fair
headlines.description: On day five of his Drive to Decision Day series, NBC News senior national politics reporter Jon Allen joins Meet the Press NOW to break down his one-on-one with Attorney General Todd Blanche at the Iowa State Fair in Des Moines.

headlines.title: ‘Fed up with a war they didn't want’: Midwestern voters air frustrations impacting the midterms
headlines.description: Senior National Politics Reporter Jonathan Allen joins Meet the Press NOW to discuss his conversations with frustrated voters on the ground in Iowa and Ohio ahead of the midterms in his Drive to Decision Day series.

headlines.title: ‘Resign. You’re destroying the country’: Republican voter in key Ohio district slams Trump
headlines.description: NBC News Senior National Politics Reporter Jon Allen cruises down I-80 in his Drive to Decision Day series to talk to voters in several battleground congressional districts that could determine the control of Congress. On day 3 of his road trip, Jon Allen visits Ohio’s 7th and 9th congressional districts.

headlines.title: Trump ‘doesn’t have a plan’ on Iran: Voters in key Pennsylvania district upset with handling of war
headlines.description: NBC News Senior National Politics Reporter Jon Allen hits the road for his Drive to Decision Day series to talk to voters in several battleground congressional districts that could determine the control of Congress. Jon Allen starts his road trip in New Jersey’s 7th congressional district and Pennsylvania’s 7th and 8th congressional districts.

headlines.title: Trump calls for a Bombardier plane ban, drawing pushback from a GOP senator
headlines.description: President Donald Trump asserted Monday that the Canadian aerospace company Bombardier should no longer be allowed to sell its planes in the U.S., opening a new front in his trade war with Canada.

headlines.title: Iran increases gasoline price for its heaviest consumers as economy struggles
headlines.description: TEHRAN, Iran — Iran early Tuesday introduced a higher price for its heaviest users of gasoline, state media reported, in the latest economic pinch caused by months of war.

headlines.title: Ohio Democrat Amy Acton reflects on a ‘rough day’ as witnesses recall ‘frightening’ confrontation
headlines.description: Democrat Amy Acton vowed to continue on as a “fierce warrior” in her campaign for Ohio governor Monday, a day after law enforcement officials said an armed man aggressively attempted to confront her at a county fair.

headlines.title: Trump asks Supreme Court to allow mail ballot restrictions to move forward for third time
headlines.description: The Trump administration asked the Supreme Court to temporarily allow the U.S. Postal Service to exert some control over mail-in voting in the upcoming midterm elections. It’s the third time the Trump administration has escalated the matter to the Supreme Court, as North Carolina last week became the first state to begin sending mail-in ballots to voters less than 60 days before the midterm elections. NBC News' Monica Alba reports.

headlines.title: Jared Kushner Defends Record Amid New Russia-Ukraine Talks
headlines.description: After being stalled for months, President Donald Trump is restarting peace talks with Russia and Ukraine, dispatching his envoys Steve Witkoff and son-in-law Jared Kushner to Kyiv to meet with President Volodymyr Zelenskyy. Kushner and Witkoff say their goal is to arrange trilateral negotiations “very soon,” with Kushner adding “these things take time.” NBC’s Richard Engel reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Armed Man Arrested After Lunging at Ohio Governor Candidate
headlines.description: Authorities say an armed man lunged at Ohio gubernatorial candidate Amy Acton as she spoke at a local fair on Sunday. Her campaign says security stopped the man from reaching the candidate, but several people were injured as he pushed his way through the crowd. NBC’s Maggie Vespa reports for TODAY.
